messages:
Nora: Quick summary from three onboarding calls today. Main signals: per-route billing toggle hidden, no quick cost examples, request for staging/team API keys.
Ethan: counts? which accounts and renewal exposure?
Nora: LedgerCo (paid, renewal Q1, flagged), BrightMD (pilot, 2 teams), SkyLabs (trial, security asks).
Rina: UX fix idea: add a highlighted badge next to routes + inline tooltip linking to a short cost preview page. Small scope.
Tom: engineering estimate: 1 dev day to surface the toggle + 0.5 day for tooltip + link to docs.
Ethan: prioritize for LedgerCo outreach. If we can canary the UI change next week, it could reduce churn risk.
Nora: I'll schedule a 15m walkthrough with LedgerCo and include the temporary step-by-step in the ticket.
Rina: team-API-keys is larger (auth + RBAC). Log it as backlog item and raise in roadmap triage.
Ezra-bot: CS-4112 created: "Onboard friction: surface billing toggle + cost-preview docs" assigned to Rina, priority P1 for LedgerCo follow-up.
Tom: I'll prototype the UI change and post screenshots to the ticket.
Nora: tagging signals: onboarding-ux, billing-visibility, api-keys-request. Will paste transcribed quotes into the ticket.
Ethan: can finance produce a simple cost-per-10k/100k tokens table for docs? CSMs need numbers now.
Nora: requested it; will share here when available.
Rina: plan: mock + tooltip + docs update. ETA 72h.
Nora: thanks team
